title: Complexity of Weisfeiler–Leman graph identification
exact_target: Is deciding whether a finite nonempty simple uncolored graph has WL identifying dimension at most a binary integer k EXPTIME-complete under deterministic polynomial-time many-one reductions, using ordinary color refinement in dimension one and joint tuple refinement at higher dimensions?
